def test_usd_payee_with_comma_is_quoted():
    import csv
    import io

    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    assert text.splitlines()[1] == 'chk-100,2024-06-02,"Smith, Jones LLP",12.50,retainer'
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))
    assert rows[1] == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]


def test_quotes_and_newlines_round_trip():
    import csv
    import io

    lines = [
        Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", 'Müller, "Gebr." AG', 100, "line1\nline2", "EUR"),
    ]
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(export_statement(lines), newline="")))
    assert rows[1] == ["eur-1", "2024-06-02", 'Müller, "Gebr." AG', "1.00", "line1\nline2"]
EOF
